annotations.title: Inspect URLs in Google Search Console

description: Run Google Search Console's URL Inspection on up to 10 URLs of the connected property: index/coverage state, last crawl time, Google-selected vs declared canonical, and mobile/rich-results verdicts. Use it to answer 'is this page indexed? why not?'. Read-only and FREE (no credits) — Search Console is first-party data and meters nothing. Every submitted URL comes back as a row, but a row carrying `error` was NOT inspected: Google refused or failed on it, so its index state was not measured rather than found to be bad. Count the rows without an `error` when saying how many URLs you checked. A verdict of UNKNOWN is Google's own 'no determination', not a page that is missing from the index.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language for the inspection result (e.g. 'en-US').

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

urls.description: 1–10 absolute URLs to inspect. Each must belong to the connected property.

name: inspect_urls
